quiz.question_id: Mengapa parameter variadic wajib berada di akhir daftar parameter?

Karena Go hanya mengizinkan satu parameter total
Agar fungsi otomatis menjadi generic
options_en: So that the variable-length arguments do not make later parameters ambiguous to parse
Because variadic parameters must always be named `args`
Because Go allows only one parameter in total

quiz.question_id: Mengapa `sum(nums)` salah jika `nums` bertipe `[]int`, tetapi `sum(nums...)` benar?
quiz.question_en: Why is `sum(nums)` wrong when `nums` has type `[]int`, but `sum(nums...)` is correct?
options_id: Karena slice harus di-spread dengan `...` agar elemennya diperlakukan sebagai argumen variadic individual
Karena `sum` tidak menerima slice sama sekali meskipun variadic
Karena `...` mengubah slice menjadi map
Karena `sum(nums)` hanya salah di Windows
options_en: Because the slice must be expanded with `...` so its elements are treated as individual variadic arguments
Because `sum` can never accept a slice even when variadic
Because `...` turns the slice into a map
Because `sum(nums)` is only wrong on Windows

Because variadic functions may not use loops
